description_en: Invokes ApplyNodes to add one or more compute nodes that use the pay-as-you-go billing method or spot compute nodes to a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用ApplyNodes添加一个或多个按量计费或抢占式计算节点到指定集群中
name: ApplyNodes

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster to which you want to add nodes.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87126.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
待添加节点的集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87126.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the image for the nodes to be added. This parameter takes effect only when TargetImageId is not specified.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87213.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87215.html operations to query the image ID.

If you add multiple nodes, only the nodes for which TargetImageId is specified use the TargetImageId value
parameters.help_zh:
待添加节点的镜像ID，仅在未指定TargetImageId时，ImageId生效。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87213.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87215.html接口获取镜像ID。

如果添加多个节点，仅指定了TargetImageId的节点会使用TargetImageId
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The preemption policy for compute nodes. Valid values:

NoSpot: nodes that use the pay-as-you-go billing method.

SpotWithPriceLimit: spot instances with Settings for the maximum price limit.

SpotAsPriceGo: spot instances for which the system automatically bids based on the current actual marketplace price.

Default value: NoSpot
parameters.help_zh:
计算节点抢占策略。取值范围：

NoSpot：按量计费节点。

SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。

SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。

默认值：NoSpot
parameters.name: compute_spot_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The maximum hourly price for compute nodes. The value is a floating-point number and supports up to three decimal places. This parameter takes effect when ComputeSpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

If both ComputeSpotPriceLimit and InstanceTypeModel.N.MaxPrice are specified, compute nodes are created based on the smaller value of the two parameters
parameters.help_zh:
计算节点每小时最高价格，取值是浮点数，最多支持3位小数。参数ComputeSpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效。

当同时设置了ComputeSpotPriceLimit与InstanceTypeModel.N.MaxPrice时，按两者的最小值创建计算节点
parameters.name: compute_spot_price_limit

parameters.help_en:
The category of the system cloud disk. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra disk
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
cloud_essd: ESSD
cloud: basic disk (discontinued)
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘的云盘类型。取值范围：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
cloud：普通云盘，已停售
parameters.name: system_disk_type

parameters.help_en:
The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GB.

Valid values: 40 to 500.

Default value: 40
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘的大小。单位：GB

取值范围：40~500

默认值：40
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The hostname prefix. This helps you classify and manage nodes
parameters.help_zh: 主机名前缀。方便您分类管理节点
parameters.name: host_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: The hostname suffix. This helps you classify and manage nodes
parameters.help_zh: 主机名后缀。方便您分类管理节点
parameters.name: host_name_suffix

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to assign a public IP address. Valid values:

true: Assigns a public IP address.

false: Does not assign a public IP address.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否分配公网地址。取值范围：

true：分配公网地址

false：不分配公网地址

默认值：false
parameters.name: allocate_public_address

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the elastic IP address (EIP). Valid values:

PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth

PayByTraffic: pay-by-data-transfer
parameters.help_zh:
弹性公网IP付费类型。取值范围：

PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽收费

PayByTraffic：按使用流量计费
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The maximum inbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

If the purchased outbound public bandwidth is less than or equal to 10 Mbit/s: 1 to 10. Default value: 10.

If the purchased outbound public bandwidth is greater than 10 Mbit/s: 1 to the value of InternetMaxBandWidthOut. Default value: the value of InternetMaxBandWidthOut
parameters.help_zh:
公网入带宽最大值，单位为Mbit/s。取值范围：

当所购公网出带宽小于等于10Mbit/s时：1~10，默认为10。

当所购公网出带宽大于10Mbit/s时：1~InternetMaxBandWidthOut的取值，默认为InternetMaxBandWidthOut的取值
parameters.name: internet_max_band_width_in

parameters.help_en:
The maximum outbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
公网出带宽最大值，单位为Mbit/s。取值范围：0~100

默认值：0
parameters.name: internet_max_band_width_out

parameters.help_en:
The number of vCPUs. This parameter is required when ResourceAmountType is set to Cores.

You can specify both vCPU and Memory to define node specifications. For example, vCPU=2 and Memory=16 define all node specifications that have 2 vCPUs and 16 GB of memory. The system determines the available node specifications based on factors such as node specifications and zones, and creates nodes with the lowest price based on price sorting
parameters.help_zh:
vCPU个数。当参数ResourceAmountType为Cores时，该参数为必选。

同时指定vCPU和Memory可以定义节点规格。例如，vCPU=2、Memory=16可以定义配置为2 vCPU、16 GB的所有节点规格。结合节点规格、可用区等因素确定可用节点规格集合，并根据价格排序为您创建价格最低的节点
parameters.name: cores

parameters.help_en:
The memory size. This parameter is required when ResourceAmountType is set to Cores. Unit: GB.

You can specify both vCPU and Memory to define node specifications. For example, vCPU=2 and Memory=16 define all node specifications that have 2 vCPUs and 16 GB of memory. The system determines the available node specifications based on factors such as node specifications and zones, and creates nodes with the lowest price based on price sorting
parameters.help_zh:
内存大小，当参数ResourceAmountType为Cores时，该参数为必选。单位：GB。

同时指定vCPU和Memory可以定义节点规格。例如，vCPU=2、Memory=16可以定义配置为2 vCPU、16 GB的所有节点规格。结合节点规格、可用区等因素确定可用节点规格集合，并根据价格排序为您创建价格最低的节点
parameters.name: memory

parameters.help_en:
The level of the instance family. This parameter takes effect only when Cores and Memory are specified. Valid values:

EntryLevel: entry-level.

EnterpriseLevel: enterprise-level.

CreditEntryLevel: credit-based entry-level. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59977.html.

Default value: EnterpriseLevel
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格族级别，在指定Cores和Memory时才生效。取值范围：

EntryLevel：入门级。

EnterpriseLevel：企业级。

CreditEntryLevel：积分入门级。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59977.html。

默认值：EnterpriseLevel
parameters.name: instance_family_level

parameters.help_en:
The expected resource count to add. The specific resource count depends on the value of ResourceAmountType.

If ResourceAmountType is set to Instances, valid values of TargetCapacity: 1 to 200.

If ResourceAmountType is set to Cores, valid values of TargetCapacity: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh:
期望添加的资源数量，具体资源数量依赖ResourceAmountType取值。

当ResourceAmountType取值为Instance时，TargetCapacity取值范围：1~200

当ResourceAmountType取值为Cores时，TargetCapacity取值范围：1~1000
parameters.name: target_capacity

parameters.help_en:
The type of resources to add. Valid values:

Instances: ECS instances that correspond to compute nodes.

Cores: vCPUs and memory.

Default value: Instances
parameters.help_zh:
期望添加的资源类型。取值范围：

Instances：计算节点对应的ECS实例

Cores：vCPU和内存

默认值：Instances
parameters.name: resource_amount_type

parameters.help_en:
The application policy for spot nodes. Valid values:

LowPriceResourcePlanning: attempts to create nodes in ascending order of vCPU unit price. When multiple node specifications that use the spot billing method are configured, the system preferentially creates the corresponding nodes that use spot billing.

CapacityOptResourcePlanning: comprehensively orchestrates and creates nodes based on lower prices and lower release rates.

CustomizedResourcePlanning: scales out based on predefined zones (ZoneIds.N). If a higher-priority zone has no instance inventory, the system automatically uses the zone with the next priority
parameters.help_zh:
抢占式节点申请策略。取值范围：

LowPriceResourcePlanning：按vCPU单价从低到高进行尝试创建。当设置了抢占式计费方式的多节点规格时，优先创建对应抢占式计费节点。

CapacityOptResourcePlanning：按照价格更低及释放率更低的方式综合编排创建。

CustomizedResourcePlanning：根据预先定义的可用区（ZoneIds.N）扩容。当优先级较高的可用区没有实例库存时，自动使用下一优先级的可用区
parameters.name: priority_strategy

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to strictly meet the quantity requirement of TargetCapacity. Valid values:

true: If the inventory is insufficient, no nodes are created and an error is returned. If the inventory is sufficient, the following two situations may occur:
If StrictResourceProvision is set to true: The system checks the inventory and creates nodes only when the inventory is sufficient. The system strictly creates the expected number of nodes. Otherwise, no nodes are created.
If StrictResourceProvision is set to false: The system checks the inventory and creates nodes only when the inventory is sufficient. However, the system may create only some nodes because the real-time inventory is insufficient when nodes are created after the inventory is queried.

false: If the inventory is insufficient, the system creates some nodes based on the available inventory.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否满足TargetCapacity的数量要求。取值范围：

true：如果库存不足，则不创建任何节点并返回报错。如果库存充足，会存在以下两种情况：
StrictResourceProvision为true：检查库存，如果库存充足才会创建节点，并严格按期望数量创建节点，否则就不创建任何节点。
StrictResourceProvision为false：检查库存，如果库存充足才会创建节点，但实际可能会因为先查询库存量，创建节点时实时库存不足而创建部分节点。

false：如果库存不足，则按库存量创建部分节点。

默认值：true
parameters.name: strict_satisfied_target_capacity

parameters.help_en:
When creating an ESSD standard SSD as the system cloud disk, the Settings for the performance level of the cloud disk. Valid values:
PL0: A single ESSD can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: A single ESSD can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: A single ESSD can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: A single ESSD can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

Default value: PL0.
For more information about how to select the performance level of an ESSD, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.help_zh:
创建ESSD云盘作为系统盘使用时，设置云盘的性能等级。取值范围：
PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

默认值：PL0
关于如何选择ESSD性能等级，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: system_disk_level

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the quantity requirement of TargetCapacity must be strictly met. This parameter takes effect when StrictSatisfiedTargetCapacity is set to true. Valid values:

true: The system checks the inventory and creates nodes only when the inventory is sufficient. The system strictly creates the expected number of nodes. Otherwise, no nodes are created.
false: The system checks the inventory and creates nodes only when the inventory is sufficient. However, the system may create only some nodes because the real-time inventory is insufficient when nodes are created after the inventory is queried.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否必须满足TargetCapacity的数量要求。当StrictSatisfiedTargetCapacity为true时生效。取值范围：

true：检查库存，如果库存充足才会创建节点，并严格按期望数量创建节点，否则就不创建任何节点。
false：检查库存，如果库存充足才会创建节点，但实际可能会因为先查询库存量，创建节点时实时库存不足而创建部分节点。

默认值：false
parameters.name: strict_resource_provision

parameters.help_en:
The total number of batches for creating nodes in batches. Valid values: 1 to 10.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分批创建节点的总批数。 取值范围：1~10

默认值：1
parameters.name: round

parameters.help_en:
The time interval between batches for creating nodes in batches. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 60 to 600.

Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
分批创建节点的时间间隔。单位：秒，取值范围：60~600

默认值：60
parameters.name: interval

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch for the nodes to be added. Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh: 待添加节点的交换机ID。N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the zone for the nodes to be added. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

Multiple zone IDs must be unique
fields.help_zh:
待添加节点的可用区ID。N的取值范围：1~10。

多个可用区ID之间不能相同
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The zone information. You can add up to 10 zones
parameters.help_zh: 可用区信息。最多可以添加10个
parameters.name: zone_infos

fields.help_en:
The node specifications to be added. By default, the compute node specifications used during the last scale-out or cluster creation are used.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
待添加的节点规格，默认使用上次扩容或者创建集群时的计算节点规格。

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: instance_type

fields.help_en:
The maximum hourly price that you are willing to pay for the spot instance. The value is a floating-point number and supports up to three decimal places.

This parameter takes effect only when ComputeSpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
您可以为该抢占式实例支付的每小时最高价格。取值是浮点数，最多支持3位小数。

当参数ComputeSpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时才生效。

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: max_price

fields.help_en:
The ID of the image for the nodes to be added. The image must be a Windows image.

Valid values of N: 1 to 10
fields.help_zh:
待添加节点的镜像ID，该镜像必须为Windows镜像。

N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: target_image_id

parameters.help_en: The spot instance information
parameters.help_zh: 抢占式实例信息
parameters.name: instance_type_model

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the nodes to be added. The tag key cannot be an empty string. It can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh:
待添加节点的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或 https://。

N的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the nodes to be added. The tag value can be an empty string. It can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh:
待添加节点的标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。

N的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tag information
parameters.help_zh: 标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The name of the queue to which the compute nodes are added.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92176.html operation to query existing queue names
parameters.help_zh:
计算节点加入的队列名称。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92176.html获取已有队列名称
parameters.name: job_queue

parameters.help_en:
The instance user data. The data must be encoded in Base64. The maximum size of the raw data is 16 KB. Linux operating systems support shell scripts. Windows operating systems support bat and powershell formats. Before Base64 encoding, the first line must be [bat] or [powershell].
Because the UserData Settings are not encrypted when API requests are transmitted, do not pass confidential information such as passwords and private keys in plaintext. If you must pass such information, encrypt the information, encode it in Base64, and then pass it. You can perform decryption in the same way within the instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例自定义数据。需要以 Base64 方式编码，原始数据最多为 16 KB。Linux操作系统支持shell脚本；Windows操作系统支持bat和powershell两种格式，在Base64编码前，第一行为[bat]或者[powershell]。
因为传输 API 请求时，不会加密您设置的 UserData，建议不要以明文方式传入机密的信息，例如密码和私钥等。如果必须传入，建议加密后，然后以 Base64 的方式编码后再传入，在实例内部以同样的方式反解密
parameters.name: user_data
